o.text: Inherited from Proto-Turkic *čimdi- (“to nip”). Cognate with Turkish and Gagauz çimdik, Turkish çindik (dialectal), Gagauz çindik, Chagatai چیمدیك (çimdik), Chuvash чӗпӗт (čĕp̬ĕt) and Turkmen çümmük.
Ultimately derived from Proto-Turkic *ay- (“to say”), and is related to ayıtmaq.
Imperative antonymous compound of götür- (“to take up”) + qoy- (“to put down”).
Calque of Russian Москва́ не сра́зу стро́илась (Moskvá ne srázu stróilasʹ).
